title: What to Expect
summary: What visitors will find at the 2027 National Orchid Show.

sections.heading: What to Expect

children.text: The 2027 South African National Orchid Show promises an immersive experience celebrating the beauty, science and future of orchids.

Explore breathtaking displays showcasing thousands of flowering orchids, from rare species found in nature to award-winning cultivated hybrids that demonstrate decades of careful breeding and horticultural achievement.
Browse the extensive plant sales area, where specialist nurseries from across South Africa will be joined by selected international orchid vendors.

The National Show Symposium will feature an outstanding programme of presentations by respected local and international speakers covering orchid cultivation, breeding, conservation, taxonomy, judging, sustainability and emerging scientific research.

A few practical details for the day are not yet confirmed by the Council. Opening hours, parking arrangements, the photography policy, cloakroom and plant-holding facilities, and accessibility information will each be added here once confirmed, rather than estimated in advance.
